description: This PHP source file defines the class LoggerAppenderDailyFile, which is a specialized log appender extending LoggerAppenderFile. It handles appending log entries to files with daily rollover based on date patterns. The class includes methods to set and get the date pattern used in log file naming, and overrides the setFile method to incorporate date-based filename formatting.

classes.description: A log appender class that writes log events to files with daily date pattern-based filenames. Extends LoggerAppenderFile, adding support for date-based file naming.
